title: Kim's Moon in the Pond
synopsis: Kim watches the half-lit first-quarter Moon reflected in Round Pond; ripples scramble the reflection, but not the Moon in the sky.
continuity_state: Before: The real Moon was a somewhat wider waxing crescent in 032000, several evenings before. Kim has three pebbles in violet pouch and knows Round Pond and its adult-visible dry path. After: A later evening near first quarter, Kim and her grown-up observe the Moon and its changing reflection from the dry path beside Round Pond. The violet pouch and all three pebbles return home. No stone enters the pond; no artifact is made or left behind.

related_resources.reason: A NASA explanation using Moon reflections on a lake specifically discusses how surface ripples distort the appearance of the reflected image.
NASA describes first-quarter phase appearance as a roughly half-lit disk from Earth. The scene does not teach the full orbital geometry.
